jobs.title: Engineering Manager
jobs.description:
Job Introduction
**Background:**


Agilio Software Group is a leading UK healthcare operations software provider, delivering integrated, mission critical solutions that support primary care, dental, pharmacy, hospital, and veterinary organisations. We have ambitious and exciting growth plans and are looking for talented individuals to be part of our journey. iLearn is our learning and compliance platform, supporting healthcare organisations to meet regulatory requirements, maintain workforce competence, and deliver high quality patient care.

**The Role:**


We’re looking for an Engineering Manager to join Agilio and take ownership of several of our engineering teams and products.  

The exact shape of the role will evolve, but you’ll likely be working across 3–4 engineering teams and around 6 products. It’s a broad role, so you’ll need to be comfortable balancing priorities across different teams and products and knowing where to focus your time.  

  

Agilio has grown significantly over the last seven years, bringing together around 20 businesses through acquisition. As a result, we have a large and varied portfolio of healthcare software, with products at different stages of maturity, built using different technologies and architectures.  

  

We’re investing in modernising and consolidating our technology, improving how we build and operate software, and exploring how AI can change the way our engineering teams work. This creates some interesting engineering challenges and plenty of opportunity to influence what the next stage of Agilio’s technology looks like.

**Key Responsibilities:**


You’ll be responsible for the people, delivery and engineering health of your teams and products.  

You’ll work closely with Engineering, Product and stakeholders across the business to agree priorities, solve problems and make the right decisions about where we invest our engineering time.

* Lead, coach and develop engineers across your teams.  

Support Lead Engineers and other technical leaders to take ownership and lead effectively.
* Work closely with Product to shape priorities, plans and the longer\-term direction of your products.
* Build strong relationships across the business and represent Engineering in decisions affecting your products.
* Own the technical direction and architecture across your products, working with Lead Engineers and teams to make good technical decisions and ensure they align with our wider technology direction.
* Understand the technical health of your products, including security, reliability, performance, maintainability and technical debt.
* Make sure technical risks and investment needs are understood and factored into plans alongside product and customer priorities.
* Help teams create realistic delivery plans, manage dependencies and identify risks early.
* Help remove blockers and make decisions and trade\-offs when teams need support.
* Improve engineering practices across areas such as automated testing, CI/CD, observability, security and operating software in production.
* Help teams make practical use of AI across the software development lifecycle and share what works across Engineering.
* Work with other Engineering Managers and technical leaders to solve common problems, align technical approaches and reduce unnecessary duplication across products.
* Recruit and onboard engineers as the teams grow.


Contribute to engineering initiatives that span teams and products.  

  

You’ll need to be comfortable with technology. You won’t make every technical decision, but you’ll be accountable for the technical direction of your area. You’ll need to understand the important decisions, challenge where necessary and make sure, we’re making choices that work beyond an individual team or product.  

  

You’ll also need to know when to step back and trust the engineers closest to the problem

**Our technology**


Our technology reflects the range of products that have come together as Agilio has grown.  

Most of our software is .NET, alongside products built using PHP and Python. Our products are predominantly web\-based, with a mixture of server\-side rendered applications and SPAs, alongside a smaller number of mobile applications built using Flutter.  

Today our products run across Microsoft Azure, AWS and Google Cloud, with Azure as our strategic cloud platform going forward.  

Part of the opportunity is helping us evolve this estate — making sensible decisions about where we standardise and consolidate while continuing to support and improve the products our customers rely on today.

**Essential**

* Proven experience leading and developing multiple software engineering teams.
* Previous experience in an Engineering Manager, Software Development Manager, Head of Engineering, or similar leadership role.
* Experience working closely with Product teams and business stakeholders to prioritise work and balance competing demands.
* Strong understanding of modern software development practices, including Agile delivery methodologies.
* Experience overseeing the technical direction of products and making decisions relating to architecture, security, scalability, reliability and technical debt.
* Ability to identify, assess and manage technical and delivery risks.
* Experience coaching, mentoring and developing engineers and technical leaders.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence at all levels of an organisation.
* Experience managing products or platforms across a varied technology estate.
* Good understanding of cloud\-based software environments (Azure, AWS or GCP).Experience improving engineering practices such as CI/CD, automated testing, observability and secure software development.Ability to make pragmatic decisions and trade\-offs in complex technical environments.
* Right to work in the UK.

**Additional Information**

**Job type:** The role is remote with occasional travel to one of our offices on an ad\-hoc basis.  

**Salary:** Competitive \+ generous benefits


Income Protection  

Life Assurance  

Enhanced pension  

Health Cash plan  

28 days annual leave \+ bank holidays  

Sick pay scheme  

A range of flexible benefits available through our Agilio Flex portal  

  

If you feel you have what it takes to join our team, we look forward to receiving your application!


Please note: Due to the volume of applications received, we may not be able to contact every applicant individually. We appreciate your interest in Agilio Software Group and thank you for taking the time to apply.

jobs.title: Intern Masters - Software Engineer (M/F/D)
jobs.description:
**Ready to help shape the future of aerospace technology?**

Join a young, collaborative, and agile **Validation \& Verification team** that thrives on trying new things, testing innovative solutions, and ensuring world\-class quality.


If you're a 4th or final\-year Engineering Master's student with a passion for programming, this hybrid internship is a unique opportunity to gain real\-world experience while working on cutting\-edge aerospace products and services.


*We believe in investing in talent for the long term, giving you the chance to grow with us even after graduation.*

Based in Brno, Czech Republic, you will work in a **flexible hybrid environment.**  



***Please note that due to export restrictions, we will only be able to take into consideration applicants with an EU citizenship.***

***Honeywell Aerospace products and services*** *are found on aircraft across commercial aviation, defense and space — from engines and cockpit electronics to cabin systems, mechanical components and connectivity solutions. Our technology helps operators fly more safely, reduce fuel consumption, improve on\-time performance and deliver a better experience for the people on board.*

*As aviation continues to evolve, we're also developing systems to support autonomous and supersonic platforms, bringing the same focus on safety and efficiency to the next era of flight. With approximately 36,000 employees worldwide and net sales of $17\.4B in 2025, Honeywell Aerospace is one of the largest dedicated aerospace companies in the world. Explore our businesses: https://www.honeywellaerospace.com*

***Electronic Solutions*** *develops the avionics, navigation systems, sensors and electromagnetic defense technology that help aircraft perform safely and with precision. Our systems are on board 90% of the world's aircraft — serving commercial aviation, defense and space operators from integrated flight deck platforms with 30\-plus years in service to radiation\-hardened systems trusted for human spaceflight.*

jobs.title: rincipal Quality Assurance Engineer
jobs.description:
##### **Job Purpose**

At Emirates, we believe in connecting the world, to and through our global hub in Dubai and in constantly innovating to ensure our customers ‘Fly Better’. As one of the most recognised and admired brands globally, we’re driven by innovation and excellence.  

Emirates Group IT thrives on the dynamic nature of technology. Being pioneers in aviation innovation, we are always at the forefront, pushing boundaries. We are seeking exceptional IT professionals to strengthen our position as industry leaders. Embark on a journey with the world’s largest international airline and become a vital part of our cutting ‑ edge information and technology team as a **Principal Quality Assurance Engineer.**As a **Principal Quality Assurance Engineer – dnata** , you will join the Quality Engineering team, where quality is fundamental to the reliability of our enterprise platforms. You will play a critical role in assuring the quality, stability, and integrity of large‑scale Cloud ERP solutions that support core financial and operational processes across the Emirates Group.  

We employ a broad range of testing tools and methodologies, leveraging industry‑standard automation frameworks and programming languages such as Java, C\#, and Python, alongside modern Cloud and DevSecOps tooling. Quality is embedded end‑to‑end through CI/CD pipelines, automation‑first strategies, and continuous improvement practices to ensure resilient, secure, and compliant Cloud ERP platforms.
 In this role, you will:
* Lead quality engineering design and build for quality engineering solutions across teams within a release train. Carry out effective technical design reviews to ensure that the right architecture patterns are used to support modern quality engineering practices.
* Plan and lead a risk\-based approach for end\-to\-end testing across all stages of development within release trains, ensuring inclusion and alignment with the business.
* Create, evaluate and implement quality engineering standards and improvements. Ensure they are being consistently implemented within release trains.
* Collaborate with the leadership and team members to identify and eliminate non\-value adding work, with the aim of driving efficiency and productivity across teams and release trains.
* Champion automation, lean software development, test driven development, agile practices, timely root cause analysis and blameless incident post\-mortems to drive continuous improvements.
* Develop/Identify framework, tools and practices to improve delivery quality of technology solutions and productivity of quality engineers.
* Foster a climate of continuous improvement amongst the team members based on scaled agile software development principles. Act as a trusted advisor for the quality engineers and guide the team to work autonomously in a multi\-disciplinary feature teams.
* Lead, coach and mentor quality engineers within a release train, providing leadership and continuous feedback whilst facilitating professional development across all areas of quality engineering.
* Ensure appropriate processes are in place to support reporting at portfolio and enterprise level to demonstrate OKR progress.

##### **Qualification**

To be considered for this role, you must meet the below requirements:  

* Degree or Honours (12\+3 or equivalent) with 8\+ years of experience in Information Technology.
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related discipline, or relevant professional experience.
* Proven experience designing and building scalable quality engineering solutions aligned to Agile Release Train objectives.
* Strong experience conducting technical design reviews and enforcing architecture standards that support modern quality engineering.
* Demonstrated ability to plan and execute risk ‑ based testing strategies across the full development lifecycle.
* Experience developing, implementing, and maintaining quality standards consistently across multiple agile teams.
* Strong collaboration skills with cross ‑ functional teams to embed quality engineering seamlessly into delivery processes.
* Proven track record of driving automation across all testing layers to minimise manual intervention and reduce human error.
* Experience leading root cause analysis and promoting blameless post ‑ mortems to drive continuous improvement.
* Strong leadership, coaching, and mentoring capability to develop quality engineers in both technical expertise and agile methodologies.
Leadership role: Yes


##### **Salary \& benefits**

Join us in a management role and enjoy an attractive tax\-free salary. On top of our generous travel benefits, including discounted flights and hotel stays around the world, this managerial role also has an excellent leave and healthcare package. That’s on top of transport benefits, life insurance and more. Find out what it’s like to live and work in our fast\-paced, cosmopolitan home city in the Dubai Lifestyle section of our website www.emirates.com/careers

jobs.title: Senior Integration Developer
Senior Software Engineer - Cloud Native (m/w)
jobs.description:
Die RIB-Gruppe ist der weltweit führende Anbieter von Softwarelösungen für die Steuerung von Projekt- und Unternehmensprozessen in der Bau- & Immobilienbranche. Mehr als 60 Jahre Branchenerfahrung befähigen uns, unser Ziel, die Bauindustrie zur nachhaltigsten und digitalisiertesten Branche des 21. Jahrhunderts voranzutreiben, mit unseren Kunden erfolgreich zu erreichen: „Building Better Together“.

Die Vision, Bauprojekte durch digitale Arbeitsmethoden effizienter und transparenter zu machen, haben wir in den letzten Jahren bei unseren Kunden Realität werden lassen - doch damit geben wir uns noch nicht zufrieden: wir wollen der Bauindustrie die Spitzenposition der Zukunft sichern!

Dies ermöglichen unsere 2.500 Mitarbeiter*innen weltweit; davon > 500 Mitarbeiter*innen in DACH. Als eigenständiges Unternehmen der Schneider Electric eröffnen wir dir dabei nationale und internationale Karrierechancen und sinnstiftende Aufgaben in kaufmännischen und technischen Bereichen. Sei ein Teil davon #ONERIB

Als Senior Software Engineer - Cloud Native im RIB 4.0 Produkt-Team treibst du die Evolution unseres Produkts hin zu einer modernen, skalierbaren und robusten Cloud-nativen Architektur maßgeblich voran. Du verbindest tiefes Software-Engineering-Wissen mit einer Leidenschaft für Automatisierung, verteilte Systeme und moderne Delivery-Prozesse.

In enger Zusammenarbeit mit dem Produktmanagement, der Entwicklung und dem zentralen Plattform-Team gestaltest du tragfähige technische Lösungen, etablierst Cloud-native Best Practices und schließt die Lücke zwischen Code und produktivem Betrieb.

Dein Neuer Verantwortungsbereich

Technische Leitung unserer Modernisierungs-Initiative.
Entwerfen, entwickeln und verbessern der Cloud-nativen Systemarchitektur.
Technische Weiterentwicklung der Applikation sowie Unterstützung von Architekturentscheidungen für eine moderne, Cloud-native Produktlandschaft.
Modernisierung bestehender Anwendungsbestandteile und containerisieren von Services mit Docker.
Du treibst Engineering Excellence im Team aktiv voran, indem du Best Practices für Softwaredesign, Code-Qualität, Testautomatisierung und strukturierte Code Reviews etablierst und kontinuierlich weiterentwickelst
Einführung moderner Observability (Monitoring, Logging, Tracing).
Shift Left: Mitwirkung bei der Integration von Sicherheits-, Qualitäts- und Betriebsanforderungen in den Entwicklungsprozess.

Dein Profil

Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung im Software-Engineering mit nachweisbarer Praxis in der Entwicklung, Modernisierung und dem Betrieb anspruchsvoller Anwendungen.
Sehr gute praktische Kenntnisse in der Entwicklung Cloud-nativer Anwendungen sowie Erfahrung mit Docker, Kubernetes.
Erfahrung mit Azure, AWS oder einem anderen Hyperscaler.
Ausgeprägtes Verständnis moderner Entwicklungs- und Delivery-Praktiken, einschließlich CI/CD, automatisierter Tests und GitOps-basierter Deployment-Strategien.
Erfahrung mit Observability-, Monitoring- und Alerting-Konzepten sowie deren technischer Integration in produktive Anwendungen.
Sehr gute Kommunikations- und Kollaborationsfähigkeiten sowie die Fähigkeit, technische Entscheidungen verständlich zu vermitteln und Kolleginnen und Kollegen fachlich zu unterstützen.
Sicherer Umgang mit modernen Software-Engineering-Prinzipien und verteilten Systemen.
Ein Plus: Fundierte Kenntnisse in C# und .NET.

Was Du Bei Uns Erwarten Kannst

Motiviert durch unsere Werte & Vision, treiben wir die digitale Transformation bei unseren Kunden voran – für ein digitales, effizienteres und nachhaltigeres Ingenieur- und Bauwesen. „Building Better Together“ ist für uns mehr als ein Slogan. Denn neben unseren Kunden stehst du im Vordergrund. Damit du deine Leidenschaft für deine Aufgaben voll entfalten kannst, unterstützen wir dich durch:

einen strukturierten Start: individuelles Onboarding, organisiertes Networking
Goodies wie: Mitarbeitervergünstigungen (z.B. Corporate Benefits), Prämien (z.B. zur Hochzeit, Geburt, Jubiläum), Aktienbeteiligung Schneider Electric, Mitarbeiterevents (Teamevents, Sommerfeste, …), je nach Standort: Tischkicker/ Tischtennisplatte/ Hunde geduldet, Gesundheitsmanagement (z.B. Vergünstigungen im Sportstudio, Betriebsarzt, …)
ein modernes Arbeitszeitmodell: Vertrauensarbeitszeit, flexible Arbeitszeiten, Möglichkeit hybrid zu arbeiten
Karriereentwicklung/ -perspektiven: Team- bzw. Rollenbasierte Weiterentwicklung/ Trainings, individuelle Weiterentwicklung/ Trainings, nationale und internationale Karriereperspektiven innerhalb der RIB-Gruppe oder Schneider Electric
deinen Raum für Gestaltungsmöglichkeiten: proaktives Teilen deiner Ideen/ Ansätze/ Prozessoptimierungen innerhalb des Teams, betriebliches Ideenmanagement, aktive Beteiligung an Meetings auf Team und Managementebene („RIB Town Halls“)
Wege, wie du nachhaltig sein kannst (je nach Standort & Funktion): digitale Infrastruktur, Company-Bikes, Fahrtkostenzuschuss, eAuto als Firmenwagen

UNTERNEHMENSKULTUR UND WERTE

Motiviert durch unsere Werte kreieren wir eine corporate culture, in der wir ein klares Bild davon haben, wie wir miteinander interact, kommunizieren, arbeiten, führen/ coachen, supporten und unseren Nachwuchs fördern. Dabei steht immer der Mensch im Vordergrund!

CHANCENGLEICHHEIT UND DIVERSITY

RIB fördert die Chancengleichheit von Frauen und Männern in allen Funktionen und Tätigkeitsfeldern.

Ganz gleich ob weibliche Führungskräfte, Mitarbeitende mit Behinderung, Berufseinsteigenden oder ältere Berufserfahrene – für uns zählt Engagement und die richtige Qualifikation. Der RIB Code of Conduct beschreibt dabei unsere wichtigsten Prinzipien in puncto Nationalität, ethnischer Herkunft, Religion,…

RIB VISION

Gebäude und Bauten sind für 36% des weltweiten Energieverbrauchs und fast 40% der energiebedingten CO2-Emissionen verantwortlich. Um die Branche effizienter, robuster und nachhaltiger zu machen, entwickeln wir Softwarelösungen, mit denen man im gesamten Lebenszyklus eines Bauwerks Ressourcen, Rohstoffe und Energie einsparen kann. Digitalisierung sehen wir als einen Treiber für eine nachhaltige Bauindustrie. "Building Better Together" steht dabei für das Zusammenspiel der beiden weltweit führenden Prozess- und Energietechnologien: RIB-Gruppe und Schneider Electric.

Unser Manifest beschreibt unsere Überzeugungen und Werte, die uns bei unserer Arbeit antreiben und uns gemeinsam zu Höchstleistungen inspirieren: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lfqlC37lhzk

About the Role:

We are recruiting a talented Senior .Net Engineer on behalf of our client, a leading global food-tech and delivery platform in London. In this core backend engineering position, you will design, build, and optimize high-throughput, mission-critical microservices and distributed transaction systems supporting millions of real-time orders daily.

Key Responsibilities:

Architect, implement, and maintain resilient backend services and REST/gRPC APIs using modern C# / .NET Core technologies.
Design scalable, event-driven distributed architectures capable of handling peak mealtime traffic surges with low latency.
Optimize database performance and query efficiency across relational (SQL Server, PostgreSQL) and NoSQL (Redis, MongoDB) databases.
Champion engineering excellence, writing clean, maintainable, test-driven code (TDD) with comprehensive automated test coverage.
Collaborate within cross-functional agile squads with Product Managers, UX Designers, and QA engineers to deliver robust consumer features.
Implement modern CI/CD pipelines, containerized deployments (Docker, Kubernetes), and cloud infrastructure on AWS/Azure.
Participate in architectural design reviews, mentor junior and mid-level software engineers, and conduct rigorous code reviews.

Required Skills & Qualifications:

5+ years of software engineering experience specializing in C# and .NET Core / .NET 6/7/8 in production environments.
Proven expertise in building distributed microservices, asynchronous programming, and message queues (RabbitMQ, Kafka, Azure Service Bus).
Solid understanding of software design patterns, Clean Architecture, Domain-Driven Design (DDD), and SOLID principles.
Hands-on experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS or Azure), containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and monitoring tools (Datadog, Prometheus).
Strong relational and non-relational database design and query tuning skills.
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related technical discipline.
Excellent collaboration and English communication skills.

What the Role Offers:

Highly competitive base salary, performance bonus, and equity stock plan.
Comprehensive private healthcare, generous workplace pension contribution, and cycle-to-work scheme.
Hybrid work setup balancing home working with visits to state-of-the-art London offices.
Annual personal technology and professional training stipend.
